headline: Shelf and Expanse Rattle On as Latch Goes Quiet
war_summary: Three hours further into the 209th day finds the ledger turned at the two hottest districts. The Weathered Expanse, listed earlier as Colonial-held, now shows five Warden posts to three Colonial with one destroyed, with 58 changes in the day and nine in the last two hours around Shattered Advance, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest, alongside 8,501 Colonial and 10,011 Warden casualties in 24 hours. Stlican Shelf has likewise reversed to six Warden to three Colonial, posting 54 changes in the day and eleven in two hours at Breaker Town, Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House. Callahan's Passage, by contrast, now stands ten Warden to none, its 18 daily changes all at The Latch but nothing in the last two hours. Linn Mercy remains eight Colonial to three Warden with twelve daily changes centered on The Long Whine but silent these two hours, as are Marban Hollow with thirteen changes at Mox and Viper Pit with eight at Blackthroat. Godcrofts counts twenty-three changes with one post destroyed, Dead Lands sixteen, and Stonecradle twelve in a five-to-four divide, all without a flip in the last two hours.
